In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], during the months leading up to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] mounted a '''rescue mission''' to recover several Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had escaped from the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] infamous [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]] aboard the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Genue]]''.<ref name="XWOSG" />

The prisoners' escape was quickly discovered and a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] sent to board and search ships near [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in an effort to recapture the prisoners.<ref name="XWOSG" />

The Rebel Alliance also learned of the escape and dispatched [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Cardacs]], a friend of Raider, in [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearheads]] to lead a rescue mission. Farlander destroyed the Imperial transport just before it boarded the ''Genue'' and the Rebel [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Drago]]'' soon came and boarded the freighter in order to lead it to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], while the two R-22s repelled [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] assaults from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Intrepid (Imperial I-class)|''Intrepid'']]. Cardacs was killed while protecting the boarding operation.<ref name="XWOSG" />

The escapees then informed the Alliance of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] slaves gathered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to work for a [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|secret project]], with the newly rescued Captain [[Samuel Raider]] leading [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] on a [[Rescue of enslaved Wookiees|rescue mission]].<ref name="XWOSG" />
